segments.name: Oncology
segments.description: Development and commercialization of telomerase inhibitor therapeutic products for blood cancer treatment.
segments.evidence: We view our operations as a single segment, the development of therapeutic products for oncology.

revenueModel.text: Patients and healthcare systems pay for RYTELO through U.S. product sales and Named Patient Programs outside the U.S.
revenueModel.evidence: To date, our primary source of product revenue has been from the U.S. sales of RYTELO, which we began shipping to our customers in June 2024.

changes.text: In 2024, RYTELO was FDA approved and commercial launch occurred in June 2024.
changes.evidence: We commercially launched RYTELO in the U.S. in June 2024 following its approval by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, or FDA, on June 6, 2024

changes.text: In 2025, RYTELO received European Commission approval for treatment of adult patients with transfusion-dependent anemia due to lower-risk MDS.
changes.evidence: In March 2025, we received European Commission (EC) approval of RYTELO for the treatment of adults with TD anemia due to lower-risk MDS without an isolated deletion 5q cytogenetic (non-del 5q) abnormality and who had an unsatisfactory response to or are ineligible for ESAs.
